title: Case Status Dashboard
mission: Turn the tracker into an operational board: show what is open, what is verified, what needs a counter-source, what is privacy-blocked, and what record should be pulled next.
boundary: Status is operational, not a verdict. A verified source route proves only the record it contains. Association is not guilt; open leads stay open until a source changes the confidence grade.

laneStatus.nextAction: Attach source records to each case type and separate confirmed findings from allegations and open leads.
laneStatus.recordToPull: court findings, enforcement actions, settlements, institutional reviews, public denials and counter-sources
laneStatus.successCondition: Every wrongdoing card has a source route, grade and what-it-cannot-prove line.

laneStatus.nextAction: Start moving tasks from open to pulled / verified / rejected as records are added.
laneStatus.recordToPull: source records listed in Top 50 Evidence Pull List
laneStatus.successCondition: Status counts update when records are pulled or rejected.

laneStatus.nextAction: Connect the pull list to every people, institution, money and speculation card.
laneStatus.successCondition: Every tracker page has a next-record-to-pull route.

laneStatus.nextAction: Verify visible source-map nodes against EFTA01104262/EFTA01104263 and classify each as map item only.
laneStatus.recordToPull: original PDF, DOJ disclosure route and independent public records
laneStatus.successCondition: Every visible node has source page, label, confidence and boundary.

laneStatus.nextAction: Add dated wealth source, SEC/ADV route, foundation route and public response lane to each priority card.
laneStatus.recordToPull: SEC EDGAR, Form ADV, foundation filings, political-money records and public responses
laneStatus.successCondition: Top wealth cards have dated source and confidence grade.

laneStatus.nextAction: Add record-ready cards for banks, foundations, universities, law, media, tech, politics, property/entity and regulators.
laneStatus.recordToPull: institutional reviews, regulator actions, filings, public statements, Form 990 and court records
laneStatus.successCondition: Each sector has at least one public record route and falsification route.

laneStatus.nextAction: Attach filing source, amount/date, recipient/sender, confidence and counter-source to each money lane.
laneStatus.recordToPull: SEC, ADV, OpenSecrets, Form 990, court settlements, procurement and corporate records
laneStatus.successCondition: Money routes show source, date, confidence and limits.

laneStatus.nextAction: Keep the page historical-only and attach court exhibits, registry context and privacy notes when available.
laneStatus.recordToPull: court exhibits, released logs, registry context and FAA privacy policy routes
laneStatus.successCondition: Transport evidence separates owner, operator, charter and passenger claims.

laneStatus.nextAction: Add one proving source and one counter-source route to each high-risk speculation claim.
laneStatus.recordToPull: official record, court source, primary document, counter-source or debunk
laneStatus.successCondition: High-risk claims have support standard and falsification route.

laneStatus.nextAction: Route email readers into Tracker Dashboard, Wrongdoing Tracker, Pull List and Source Vault.

laneStatus.successCondition: Newsletter page converts readers into repeat tracker users.
